The new claimed_strays(ctx, tree, paths) maps plan spelling to git spelling with _config.plan_to_git, asks follower_claims, and maps back. The owners are asked only when paths are left after the declared and gate-owed exclusions. A start with nothing left to ask is marked straysSettled, so the owners run once per start and not at every step. Claimed paths stay with the integration, which reproduces them or prints the browser follow.
